given.note: Refused: S1-10's link opened with no session, answered as if opening it proved the browser was Sam's (proof session, acting for Sam, secure-page-only sections shown). Opening a link never counts as proof of who someone is (FS line 701; S13-45: 'Opening a link never counts'), so the call acts for no one until a session of the link's own person comes with it. Its one fault is the missing session: with Sam's session in the request, as open-link-signed-in.json has Riley's, the same answer is accepted; with no session, the answer is open-link-secure-page.json's.
